translations.web: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”
translations.bsb: He announced, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders through this day!”
translations.kjv: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
